name: Bala Ged
description: Bala Ged is one of the seven continents of Zendikar, once known for dense jungles and deadly marshes, and the home continent of Nissa Revane, overrun and destroyed after the release of the Eldrazi.

description_citations.text: "Bala Ged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

summary.text: Bala Ged is one of the seven continents of Zendikar, once known for dense jungles and deadly marshes, and the home continent of Nissa Revane, overrun and destroyed after the release of the Eldrazi.

citations.text: "Bala Ged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Elves of Bala Ged revolted against their kor rulers and toppled their Skyclave.

citations.text: "Bala Ged", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After the Eldrazi were released, culling drones swept across the continent in huge hordes, and within two years Bala Ged was overrun and destroyed.

bio.text: Ob Nixilis felt its destruction shudder through the world, and Munda's band told Gideon it had been overrun.

citations.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.
"Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

bio.text: Nissa returned to find it consumed by white corruption, found the Khalni Heart imprisoned in a ring of hedrons, and defeated Ob Nixilis there.

"Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

"At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

status.text: As of the latest story Bala Ged is recovering, with life returned to its bogs and vampires coming back to feed on it.

timeline.summary: The elves of Bala Ged, led by the pre-spirit Obuun, revolt against their kor rulers and topple their Skyclave.
timeline.quote: The elves of Bala Ged, led by a pre-spirit Obuun , revolted against their kor rulers and toppled their Skyclave .

citation.text: "Bala Ged", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anowon acquires the Dragon's Fire scroll on an expedition, then renounces Bala Ged Expeditionary House and disappears.
timeline.quote: Anowon acquired a powerful scroll now known as the Dragon's Fire.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Bala Ged Expeditionary House". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Culling drones are unleashed in huge hordes across Bala Ged, leading to the land's consumption.
timeline.quote: They were unleashed in huge hordes across Bala Ged, leading to that land's consumption.

citation.text: "Eldrazi/Lineages", section "Culling Drone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa vows before the Joraga Council to find Sorin and bring him back to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: She told them of what had transpired and swore to find Sorin, to drag him back to Zendikar to help with the Eldrazi menace.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis says that heroes coming to fight the Eldrazi will need what he knows about the hedrons, and that he feels his spark within reach after Bala Ged's destruction.
timeline.quote: My spark is within reach.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Munda and his band find Gideon and tell him that Bala Ged has been overrun and destroyed.
timeline.quote: Bala Ged, the entire continent, has be overrun and destroyed.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The vampire offers four seeds from Anowon, including the last bloodbriar of Bala Ged, asking Nissa to take them to another plane.
timeline.quote: "Kolya, red mangrove, jaddi, bloodbriar."

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage ravage the continent of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: The continent of Bala Ged was ravaged by massive Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage

citation.text: Bane of Bala Ged (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Within two years of the release of the Eldrazi, Bala Ged is overrun and destroyed.
timeline.quote: the entire continent of Bala Ged was overrun and destroyed.

citation.text: "Bala Ged", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane finds the Khalni Heart in the devastated continent, defeats Ob Nixilis, and escapes with the Heart.
timeline.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped.

citation.text: "Bala Ged", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa beats Ob Nixilis at the Khalni Heart and escapes with it and the revived Ashaya.
timeline.quote: Flush with the elemental power of Zendikar, Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped with the revived Ashaya.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa arrives on Bala Ged and finds it entirely consumed by white corruption.
timeline.quote: The land wasn't ruined—it had been entirely consumed.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa walks to the site of her old village and is overwhelmed by memories of her past self and her departure.
timeline.quote: She wouldn't be that elf again, she couldn't be.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa instinctively kills a gomazoa-like Eldrazi and realizes it must have fed on life, leading her toward Khalni Heart.
timeline.quote: She quartered the monstrosity so quickly

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Following the Eldrazi's trail to a surrakar cave, Nissa finds a moss-lined tunnel.
timeline.quote: she saw the first sign of life.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds a ring of hedrons imprisoning the wilted Khalni Heart and realizes someone uprooted Zendikar's soul.
timeline.quote: someone had uprooted the land's soul and trapped it here to die.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: A demon attacks Nissa, mistaking her for Nahiri's emissary, and they fight.
timeline.quote: "Was it Nahiri?"

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa unleashes her wild essence to reflect the demon's life-draining blast.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, the full force of Nissa's essence came rushing back to her

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The demon reveals he plans to seize Khalni Heart's power, and Nissa breaks a hedron to open the prison.
timeline.quote: the massive rock shattered.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Khalni Heart but the demon traps her and tells her to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: "If you want to live, now is the time to planeswalk away."

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes she is neither her old self nor her controlled self and pours her essence into Khalni Heart, letting it root in the land.
timeline.quote: Nissa collected all the power left within her

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The land swallows Khalni Heart and Zendikar's soul returns to the land, defeating the demon's plan.
timeline.quote: The world's soul had returned to the land.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa drives a fist of land into the demon and rises with Ashaya, who returns as her friend.
timeline.quote: Nissa rose up, and so too did the world's soul, her friend.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya set off to return to Sea Gate and join Gideon's battle cry.
timeline.quote: Nissa and Ashaya would return to Sea Gate, they would meet Gideon's army

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis wakes buried alive after Nissa took Khalni Heart and collapsed the cavern on him.
timeline.quote: She left me alive.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls his failed plan to synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart and reignite his spark.
timeline.quote: Synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart, and use it to channel enough planar energy through my body to reignite my spark.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis weighs his options and decides he must save Zendikar to buy time to rebuild his work.
timeline.quote: I was going to have to save Zendikar.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He digs himself out over days, finding Bala Ged stripped of life so there is nothing to drain.
timeline.quote: The entire process of escape took days.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He recovers the keystone hedron of his network and uses it to sense where the last stand will be.
timeline.quote: Sea Gate, if memory served. A lovely place for a slaughter.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds the Khalni Heart in Bala Ged, restores her connection to Zendikar and defeats Ob Nixilis.
timeline.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis , removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and left the demon seething underground.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Bala Ged becomes a home of nightmares and horrors and its Skyclave rises again; it slowly recovers after Nissa uses the Lithoform Core.
timeline.quote: After Nissa Revane 's use of the healing power of the Lithoform Core , the continent slowly recovers.

citation.text: "Bala Ged", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds Bala Ged turned to lifeless gray dust.
timeline.quote: What stretched before her was a seemingly endless expanse of chalky gray dust

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees Ulamog on the horizon.
timeline.quote: The Devourer. The one Ugin called Ulamog .

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri swears that as Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad, and as she has wept, so will Sorin.
timeline.quote: As Zendikar has bled, so will Innistrad.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps at Nissa asking if she even has a mother, and Nissa reveals that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa races to Bala Ged along the leylines, finally home.
timeline.quote: Nissa was finally home.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The explosion destroys the Singing City; Zendikar begins visibly healing and Nissa discards the Core and departs.
timeline.quote: The explosion destroyed the Singing City

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage ravage Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: The continent of Bala Ged was ravaged by massive Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage, its lush jungles and cascading rivers reduced to dust.

citation.text: Bane of Bala Ged (Commander Masters, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Vampires return to the bogs of Bala Ged to feed on returned life.
timeline.quote: As life returned to the bogs of Bala Ged, the vampires returned to feed upon it.

citation.text: Sanguine Syphoner (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The northernmost part of Guul Draz shares in Bala Ged's utter destruction and becomes the Lake of Dust.
timeline.quote: shared in that region’s utter destruction

citation.text: "Guul Draz", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The explosion obliterates the Singing City and is followed by a surge of regrowth that revives regions like Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: The resulting explosion obliterated the Singing City

citation.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane finds a Khalni Heart in a cave in Bala Ged and saves it from Ob Nixilis.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane found a Khalni Heart in a cave in Bala Ged

citation.text: "Ora Ondar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Within two years of the Eldrazi's release, Bala Ged is overrun and destroyed.
timeline.quote: the entire continent of Bala Ged was overrun and destroyed

citation.text: "Tangled Vale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
